_about: Chapter 1, find the car. This file is the palette block "ch1" (levels pick it with "palette": "ch1").
Look: a realistic, dark night on a mountain road. It starts from the chosen mood (heavy) and changes what that look needs; every difference is explained in the PR description.
Fog is brighter than the things standing in it, so trees, wrecks and zombies read as dark silhouettes; the only warm colours are three small lights (camp fire, cabin window, a string of bulbs).
